test.name: Fuzz the four provider targets 10 minutes each on main after wave 2

expected: cargo xtask fuzz run runs provider_manifest, provider_template, provider_interpolation, and provider_settings_schema for 600 seconds each, one at a time, with the pinned nightly and cargo-fuzz, and finds no crash, hang, or out of memory.
actual: no crash, hang, or out of memory in any target and fuzz/artifacts/ empty; provider_manifest: 748121 runs in 601 s (1244 exec/s), 7798 new units, peak RSS 428 MB; provider_template: 189312 runs in 601 s (314 exec/s), 3624 new units, peak RSS 467 MB; provider_interpolation: 1740467 runs in 601 s (2895 exec/s), 3565 new units, peak RSS 656 MB; provider_settings_schema: 4909162 runs in 601 s (8168 exec/s), 11749 new units, peak RSS 566 MB
steps: on commit 6b3da2c (main after wave 2: the spec 0009 reconciliation of AC-7, AC-8, and AC-11, the contract 1.3 wire codes, and the feature 11 ResolvedSecrets) with a clean tree, use the pinned fuzz toolchain nightly-2026-10-17 and cargo-fuzz 0.13.2; `cargo xtask fuzz build` builds the provider targets with AddressSanitizer (default)
start from the committed seeds only (fuzz/corpus empty in this worktree): provider_manifest 4, provider_template 6, provider_interpolation 32, provider_settings_schema 4

run `cargo xtask fuzz run <target> --time 600` for provider_manifest, provider_template, provider_interpolation, and provider_settings_schema one at a time, because the Mac is shared by other sessions; the runs went from 2026-10-19T13:43:58Z to 14:25:32Z

provider_template rebuilt stackly-core before its run, and provider_interpolation and provider_settings_schema relinked their binaries, because a verify drift probe had edited and restored crates/core/src/provider/raw.rs (only the mtime changed in the end; restored at 13:53:42Z, before the template run started at 13:54:01Z, and the edited attribute is json-schema only, which the fuzz build does not enable), so every target fuzzed the source of 6b3da2c
check that each command exits 0 with `ran for 600 s without a crash`, that fuzz/artifacts/ holds no input for any target, and read the libFuzzer final stats
keep the head and tail of each log in this record's files folder (the middle NEW, REDUCE, and pulse progress lines are cut)

the fresh model review afterwards found a YAML alias bomb with a large anchor that these runs did not reach (mutations rarely build an anchor chain); it is fixed in 2a25db1 and 4ee9bf6 with regression inputs in crates/core/tests/fuzz_regressions/, and a 60 second smoke run per target on 4ee9bf6 is recorded in docs/specs/0009-provider-engine-manifest-schema/verify.md
